hints.title: Middle Pivot Decomposition
hints.text: Fix the middle cut position first to decouple the left halves and right halves of the array.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Equalities
hints.text: Compute prefix sums. For a chosen middle index, check all valid first cuts that split the left segment into two equal portions.

hints.title: Lookup Set for Shared Segment Sums
hints.text: Iterate middle index j. Collect all equal half sums on the left of j into a hash set. Then check valid right cut indices k; if sum of both right parts matches a value in the set, a valid four-part partition exists.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal O(N^2) solution using prefix sums and middle index pivoting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all triples (i, j, k) directly results in cubic O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixing middle index j splits problem into two independent halves stored in a hash set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Observe that fixing the middle partition decouples left and right equality constraints.
